scope: Node VM of actual extension-planning callbacks with a minimal dialog facade. No DOM/CSS/native close-event timing, network, registry licenses or extension host execution are verified.

tests.name: Plans do not leak between projects
Stale add callback from a previous project cannot mutate newly shown project
Stale settings callback cannot write an old plan using new dialog fields
Settings reject arrays and malformed JSON
Settings save is plan-only and preserves inert JSON data
Corporate source rejects non-HTTPS and embedded credentials
Corporate source saves without fabricating packages or making a request
Search narrows Java packages without modifying plans
Old source and search events cannot replace a newer dialog in the same project
